# Practice credential fixtures

Gameplay sections from osu!'s public `.osu` files, captured September 15–16, 2026.
Events/assets are omitted; none of these fixtures is used to rate a chart.

- `1887432`: original Aquaris 1.3×, OD 9.
- `4961182`: Delta Jack pack reupload, identical notes/timing/OD.
- `4282465`: Aquaris 1.08×, same topology but different timing.
- `3888155`: 7K LN Inverse 0th, with hold ends and a tier below the estimator table.

Sources: `https://osu.ppy.sh/osu/<id>`. The tests compare actual note content
against the player credential registry, independent of titles and upload IDs.
